fusions.name: Unhurried Finish
fusions.desc: A slow, certain hook of the claws that deals 34 damage as a critical hit and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Heavy Hang
fusions.desc: A dragging claw strike that deals 12 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and leaves it [Leaden] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: All the Time Needed
fusions.desc: After 1.5 seconds, holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Eventually
fusions.desc: When you have gone a while without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
